newsitem.title: USA: St Jude Medical Q4 loss blamed on charges.
newsitem.headline: St Jude Medical Q4 loss blamed on charges.

text.p: St Jude Medical Inc said Wednesday it recorded research-related and special charges in the fourth quarter ended December 31, resulting in a loss in the period.

The company said purchased research and development charges of $32.2 million and a special charge of $47.8 million related to acquisitions resulted in a $19.2 million loss in the quarter. Sales in the period totaled $212.7 million, up from $191.4 million last year, St. Jude Medical said.
St Jude Medical develops medical devices for the global cardiovascular market.
Its shares closed down one Wednesday at 36-1/2.
